itemListElement.name: Best Otter.ai Alternatives in the US for 2026

mainEntity.name: What is the best free alternative to Otter AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fathom has the most generous free recording, with unlimited recordings and transcripts. Lynkk's free plan is smaller at 5 notes a month, but each note includes tasks with owners and Jira send, which Otter Basic does not offer.

mainEntity.name: Is Otter AI worth it in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter is worth it if you need fast English transcription and live captions. It is less worth it if you need notes turned into tasks, in-person capture in the same tool, or meetings longer than 30 minutes on a free plan.

mainEntity.name: Why is Otter AI so expensive for teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter Business costs $30 per user per month on monthly billing, or $19.99 billed yearly. For a 10-person team that is up to $3,600 a year, which is why teams compare Fireflies, Fathom and Lynkk.

mainEntity.name: Which Otter alternative works without a bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Granola and Jamie are built around bot-free capture. Lynkk offers both: a bot for Zoom, Meet and Teams, plus a Mac app and Chrome extension that record without one.

mainEntity.name: Is there an Otter alternative that supports Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lynkk supports Hindi and has a Hinglish setting for calls that switch between Hindi and English mid-sentence. It covers 17 languages plus auto-detect in total.

mainEntity.name: Can I import my Otter transcripts into another tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most tools accept audio uploads rather than Otter's own files. Export your transcripts as TXT or DOCX from Otter and keep them in your docs. Then let the new tool capture meetings going forward.
